hints: The graph may contain cycles, but each strongly connected component can be condensed to one node.
Every coin in a component can be collected if that component is visited, because its planets are mutually reachable.
On the resulting DAG, compute the maximum collected coin total along any path.
analogy: Collapse mutually reachable planets into one prize bundle, then find the richest directed route through bundles.
example: If a component has coins 4 and 7, its bundle is worth 11; a path through it adds all 11.
algorithm: Find SCCs, sum coins per component, build the condensation DAG, and use topological DP to maximize accumulated value.
correctness: Within an SCC every member can be visited on a route between entry and exit; the condensation graph is acyclic, so a path's component weights are counted once in topological DP.
